steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); window.__gitgood.actions.setView('history'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const commits = window.__gitgood.store.get().history.commits; const sha = commits[0] && commits[0].sha; window.__gitgood.actions.selectCommit(sha); await window.__gitgood.actions.loadCommitDetails(sha); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const details = s.history.details; return JSON.stringify({ commitCount: commits.length, view: s.view, selectedShas: s.history.selectedShas, detailsSummary: details && details.commit.summary, detailsFiles: details && details.files.map((f) => f.path) }); })()
